items.title: Autobrains Brings NVIDIA Alpamayo Intelligence to the Road
items.summary: TEL AVIV, Israel, November 10, 2026--Autobrains today announced an expansion of its work with NVIDIA, incorporating the reasoning capabilities of NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super into real-world autonomous driving. Using its Agentic AI architecture, Autobrains distills Alpamayo’s foundation-model intelligence into specialized Driving Agents that reason and act in real time in production vehicles.

items.title: Nvidia sued by investors over ‘Chinese spy’ affair
items.summary: Nvidia is facing a legal challenge from investors over claims the company lied about Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
